text: Validators who align with the stake weighted consensus ranking gain reputation and those who deviate lose it, which carries the winner takes losers' stakes property of the original framework over to ranked voting.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998

isBasedOn.name: Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution

abstract: Validators who align with consensus gain reputation. Those who deviate lose it. Thus, preserving the winner-takes-losers'-stakes property from the original framework (Calcaterra, Kaal, and Andrei 2018, 7) while extending it to ranked voting.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: validator agreement measured by normalized Kendall tau distance from consensus
